findings.reason: without it the move is dispatched, the module leaves reckon/crew/, and a reader of a-window-paces-the-lane is sent to a path that no longer exists while every stated measure still passes; the plane's own promise to update prose naming the old path cannot be met inside its fence.
findings.text: §4 promises "A docstring or prose that names the old module path is updated to the script path", but its write paths exclude docs/, and its done-when's `git grep` is scoped to "reckon/ tests/ skills/ scripts/ and the research scripts", so the section can pass while an active plan still points at a removed module: docs/plans/a-window-paces-the-lane.html:1109 and :1234 describe "reckon/crew/pace_replay.py" as the current landed path (plan-status active); docs/plans/a-review-dies-where-nobody-is-looking.html:398 names "reckon/crew/carryover_census.py" as producer of session-carryover.json (plan-status active). The node is fenced out of editing another plan, so the fix must be an explicit scope handling (a follow-on routing the two plans' citations, or a declared retention of live-plan prose alongside the data-provenance retention the section already allows)

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: a finding — §4 moves reckon/crew/{carryover_census,death_census,pace_replay}.py out of the package, but two active plans cite those module paths as current facts and neither lies in §4's write paths or its grep scope.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §4's done-when is measurable (each script's `--help` exits 0; the moved tests and the four rewritten staying tests pass; a scoped git grep returns no hit; the ratchet passes) and names a declared negative control (an old import left in a test fails at collection).
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — no gate log or evidence path is placed in a session scratchpad or a node-local temporary directory; the section defers to the run record as the other sections do.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the new scripts' symbols and comments carry no plan label, stage name, ticket number or version tag, and no changelog prose.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the stated root cause matches §1's cited reach evidence; §4's mechanism (move + add an argparse `main()` behind a `__main__` guard + rewrite imports) can produce its done-when; and the one-off scripts' entry point is named (run by hand from scripts/census/ with `--help`), so no production caller is required.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §4 carries one deliverable: move the three one-off census modules out of the package.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §4 declares its dependency on §2's ratchet allowlist and on §3 (both edit tests/test_every_module_is_reached.py) and runs after §3; the only plan-level relation, the §6 gate g-tcirbn-reach-instrument, is owned by another plan and is correctly left unexpressed in plan-standalone.
